div.head: Ger 4
div.ab: Ac ic lære þæt he do swa ic ær cwæð. gyme ægðer ge ðæs sel|ran. ge þæs sæmran . þæt naðor ne misfare gyf he wealdan mæge . ne corn . ne sceaf . ne flæsc . ne slotsmeru [could be as 17.]. ne cyse . ne cys|lyb. ne nan ðera ðinga ðe æfra to note mæge .

But I advise that he do just as I said before: take care of both the better and of the worse so that nothing go wrong if he may prevent it; not corn nor sheaf, nor flesh nor morsel of fat, nor cheese nor rennet, nor any of those things which may ever be of note.

[4] Ac ic lære, þæt he do, swa ic ær cwæð: gyme ægðer ge ðæs selran ge þæs sæmran, þæt naðor ne misfare, gyf he wealdan mæge, ne corn ne sceaf, ne flæsc ne flotsmeru, ne cyse ne cyslyb, ne nan ðera ðinga ðe æfra to note mæge.
